comparison.objective: Clamp an edge-glued panel with three clamps alternating above and below.
comparison.physical_skill: Place a clamp, close multiple sliding jaws, regulate clamping force, and maintain panel alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Joint closed and level with three snug alternating clamps; excessive force permanently fails; hands clear and assembly still.
comparison.reason: Tests distributed force application and clamp layout, not locking a rotary adjustment without disturbing it or checking repeated actuator return.
